selection: Purposive diagnostic selection: one trace per seven parsers, spanning short controls, distant repetition, clipped history, skipped input/tool output, intermediate action versus later completion, and missing task text. Not random or representative. Three source traces have no-issue consensus and four have an issue. Status was used for coverage, not to assign local references.
reference_method: Single assistant review of all normalized events in each selected trace, with repeated identical MetaGPT contents grouped for reading. References fixed before opening selected numeric Jev answers. Ordinal ranges express review uncertainty, not human gold truth. Conversation labels and references are never sent to the scorer. Future events are excluded from each focal judgment.
contrasts: cached original versus fresh identical request (run/model drift control)
fresh original versus expanded history with identical focal endpoints, task and rubrics
short and expanded context at three reviewed alternative endpoints; endpoint changes have separate references and are not pooled as same-event improvements
limitations: Only a diagnostic case series; no MAST accuracy or population estimate.
Alternative endpoints may change the observation horizon and meaning of fulfillment.
No proof of causation or exact reply identity from temporal proximity.
Harmfulness has only a benign sanity check; other dimensions have unequal reference coverage.
Source task and focal content are held fixed in the context contrast; missing original tasks are not reconstructed.
